about: Central Elgin is a municipality in Elgin County, Ontario, on Lake Erie south of St. Thomas, covering Port Stanley, Belmont, and surrounding countryside—not a single city. Beaches, harbour, and farm roads share the landscape between London’s south orbit and the Erie shore. About 14,000 people live in Central Elgin.
